title: Choose the composer surface
question: Compare the same composer in light and dark. Only the surface and elevation differ.

options.label: Bordered neutral
options.thesis: A quiet input surface separated by a fine outline.
options.viewport: The existing compact composer, unchanged in size and behavior, in both themes.
options.risk: Quieter separation from the surrounding chat.

options.label: Raised neutral
options.thesis: A more distinct input surface with a short shadow.
options.viewport: The same compact composer, unchanged in size and behavior, in both themes.
options.risk: More visually prominent than the bordered variant.
